answer: A sybil-resistant economy gates influence on cost-bearing reputation rather than count. Each identity deposits skin-in-the-game and earns standing only through attested, non-kin-scored work; the deposit grows with the stakes it touches, so flooding the inlet with shells forces an attacker to fund real capital and compute per fake. Over the horizon, honest agents compound verified reputation while clones bleed pigment-like value, making impersonation structurally unprofitable.
